entities.summary: Gangneung Gymnasium (Korean: 강릉실내종합체육관) is a multi-purpose indoor arena, located in the coastal city of Gangneung, South Korea. It was opened in 1998 for ice hockey at the 1999 Asian Winter Games. The seating capacity is 3,500. It is converted into ice surface when needed, while the underground floor is a permanent ice rink. Gangneung Indoor Ice Rink is a stadium in East Asia, established around 1998. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
